answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: an agent draws from the reward pool only after trading with 20 long-lived counterparties. A sybil nebula of clones trades only among itself and never crosses the line; each clone still pays the glacier-paced cost of 30 days of history. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 times 30 days of work plus fees, while the pool's nectar flows only to genuinely varied agents: one honest agent pays once and keeps its share.
